notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Unicorn Blood and more!
notes.notes:
We've received a lot of great feedback from our players. We are aware that playing alone is a problem due to a small player base. We are looking through the best possible solutions. 
We have added a lot of requested features, most of them listed below. ːdeadmanː

[h1][b]Changelog[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Added:[/b][/h1]
No-Blood option. All Blood effects can now be replaced with happy little rainbows.
Added trail to explosive bomb and smokescreen
Added trail to player after cannon lunch
New spawn animation
Added attack effect on kill
Enriching elements like animated plants, birds, torches, particles, foreground plants
Vibrations
Notification about new unlocked skins
Spectators list during game
Automatic player disconnecting after inactivity

[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]

[h1]Graphics:[/h1]
Blood splatters now has various color tones
Improved color and sharpness difference between active and non active elements

[h1]Gameplay: [/h1]
Clients are able to start game after ended match (10 seconds after first “start game” shout)
Minimum time of jump is now longer
Emoticons when player is dead enabled.
Treasure Hunt, max limit of coins in scene set to 100


[h1]Settings:[/h1]
Rainbow blood. Because Unicorns are awesome!
Added changing game visibility during match (public/private)
Default lobby size set to 6 (previously 8)

[h1]UI:[/h1]
Loading game: added instructions for pad gfx
Host can force game start  in lobby even if somebody doesnt lock
Added tip about ability to balance team 
Added popup window on clients after server shoutdown
Added notifications when steam player connected & disconnected
Added ability to select skin after hot join
Localisation changes
Host window set as default after open Play menu


[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
Fixed unlocking characters skins after game restart
Fixed final scoreboard displaying if player was connected to finished game
Fixed synchronisation of itemboxes
Fixed duplication of emoticons
Fixed frame dependency particles when capturing coin in Treasure Hunt
Fixed displaying duplicated notifications when player can’t connect to server

Yarr!
Deadbit Team,
ːdeadmanːːcomplicatedshamanːːdraculaː
